name: Kamishiro Yukari
source:
Yukari, or "Yukarin" as she is known by her friends, is a third-year student at Shimano Academy, and she also works as a maid at the Fujimiya Residence. She acts older than her age and is skilled at treating injuries. She tends to speak with a quiet voice. Her reason that she works there is that she has lost a portion of her past memories, and seems to have an innate ability to talk to animals. What she always likes is to cheer for others in life by saying: "Please do your best."

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gift_%28visual_novel%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
